scope: Read-only quality audit of the human-review preparation stage only. No source data, worksheets, model, active config, split, or training artifact was modified.
overall_result: The review-preparation package is structurally valid, preserves all 850 draft rows, keeps human decision fields blank, accurately attaches held-out model outputs to the 84 fresh-test cases, and reproduces the saved confusion matrix. Real human review, reviewed-dataset finalization, fresh post-review splits, and retraining remain pending.

artifact_parsing.notes: All 10 package JSON and 11 CSV files, including this QA record, parsed successfully after package completion.

held_out_prediction_attachment.interpretation: Outputs are experimental suggestions, not human decisions or established severity truth. Confidence is uncalibrated.

high_risk_disagreement_audit.interpretation: These are model disagreements with synthetic draft labels; no candidate label has been adjudicated by a human.

family_audit.limitation: The split separation check validates the current recorded family IDs only. Semantic translations, paraphrases, same-incident links, and proposed family changes still require human review.

prior_source_access_audit.interpretation: The historical-source audit documents its limited checks and does not claim the inaccessible files were inspected.

tokenizer_warning_audit.interpretation: The audit documents the local warning diagnosis and advises against applying the Mistral-specific regex fix to XLM-R.

multi_agent_execution_record.limitation: Several workstreams are explicitly prep-only, partial, or deferred pending genuine human evidence; the matrix does not represent those future stages as complete.

limitations: All 850 labels remain synthetic drafts; no human severity decisions or language reviews are present.

Sixty historical source CSVs remain inaccessible and the precise access-control cause is unresolved; no complete prior-exposure audit was possible.
